title: Efficiency over time
description: The agents' and cashiers' efficiency per app version, kept 1 year (the owner 2026-11-18): hourly roll-ups in the long-term Prometheus (README "Long-term efficiency").

list.name: app
list.label: App
list.description: callcenter = the call center's agents; terminal = Centurion's cashiers (through the Pi)

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (sum_over_time(eff:${app}_ui_search_duration_bucket:increase1h{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", version="$before", outcome="pick"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (sum_over_time(eff:${app}_ui_search_duration_bucket:increase1h{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", version="$after", outcome="pick"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Every version side by side (the time range)
Per version: orders, time, inputs per order
panels.description: Each app version over the time range: finished orders, the median time per order, and keys / clicks / searches / undo / right-clicks per order.

targets.expr: sum by (version) (sum_over_time(eff:${app}_ui_order_inputs:increase1h{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="keys"}[$__range])) / sum by (version) (sum_over_time(eff:${app}_ui_order_duration_count:increase1h{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range]))

sum by (version) (sum_over_time(eff:${app}_ui_order_inputs:increase1h{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="clicks"}[$__range])) / sum by (version) (sum_over_time(eff:${app}_ui_order_duration_count:increase1h{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range]))

sum by (version) (sum_over_time(eff:${app}_ui_order_inputs:increase1h{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="searches"}[$__range])) / sum by (version) (sum_over_time(eff:${app}_ui_order_duration_count:increase1h{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range]))

sum by (version) (sum_over_time(eff:${app}_ui_order_inputs:increase1h{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="undos"}[$__range])) / sum by (version) (sum_over_time(eff:${app}_ui_order_duration_count:increase1h{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range]))

sum by (version) (sum_over_time(eff:${app}_ui_order_inputs:increase1h{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="right_clicks"}[$__range])) / sum by (version) (sum_over_time(eff:${app}_ui_order_duration_count:increase1h{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Keys, chords and F-keys by version
panels.description: How often each named key / chord was used per version (F2, ctrl+z, Escape, /, ?…; other = anything else).

panels.title: Searches by kind and outcome, by version
panels.description: Searches by what was picked (item, alias, choice = a mod, size, customer, order) or how they were abandoned (esc, blur, cleared), per version.

panels.title: Right-click, menus, undo, screen pops by version
panels.description: right_click, context_open / context_pick (the right-click menu), undo / redo / undo_empty, screen_pop_<delivery|takeout|dismissed>, per version.

panels.title: Items by how they were found, by version
panels.description: Items added from the menu buttons, a search or a store alias, per version.

panels.title: Time on each step (median) by version
panels.description: phone, account, customer_form, menu, cash_out: the median per version.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, step, version) (sum_over_time(eff:${app}_ui_step_duration_bucket:increase1h{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Per agent and version: median time per order
panels.description: Each agent's median time per order per version: compare an agent with themselves.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, staff, version) (sum_over_time(eff:${app}_ui_order_duration_bucket:increase1h{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Over time (a point per day)
Time per order (median per day) by version
panels.description: The median order of each day, per app version: a new version's line should sit lower.

panels.title: Keys per order (per day) by version
panels.description: Keys spent per finished order each day, per version.

targets.expr: sum by (version) (sum_over_time(eff:${app}_ui_order_inputs:increase1h{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="keys"}[1d])) / sum by (version) (sum_over_time(eff:${app}_ui_order_duration_count:increase1h{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[1d]))
